digest.component_or_area: op-cert signing subsystem / MCP health surface
propositions: sign_manifest mints a certificate without checking whether the verify-side resolver can resolve a public counterpart for the specific signing key used, leaving silently-uncertifiable attestations undetected until verify_signature or claim refusal

the mint-time guard `_warn_if_verify_cannot_resolve` must emit a WARNING naming the resolved key path and principal when the specific signing key's public counterpart is absent from `_opcert_own_public_keys`, even if another chain key's pub resolves, without refusing the signature

the startup health surface must report a degraded `opcert` field and log a WARNING when the bound signer's public key does not match the pinned `rebar.attest.trusted_env` key for its principal, serving non-aborting (serve-degraded)
both guards are in-process and operation-linked with no dependency on CI provider environment, verified by unit tests exercising mint and startup checks with no CI env vars set
